# Spiking_Transformer

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A transformer architecture whose neurons communicate via sparse binary spikes and temporal event dynamics instead of continuous activations. Bridges attention-based learning with energy-efficient event-driven neuromorphic computing substrates.
